newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MBM buys stake in Colonial Motor.
newsitem.headline: MBM buys stake in Colonial Motor.

text.p: Malaysia's MBM Resources Bhd said it has signed an agreement to buy a 24.88 percent equity in New Zealand's Colonial Motor Co Ltd for NZ$20.02 million.

In a statement released over the weekend, the Malaysian vehicle distributor and parts maker said the agreement was signed with Guinness Peat Group Plc and involved 7.7 million Colonial Motor shares priced at $2.60 a share.
Colonial Motor's operating activities include 18 Ford dealerships and the distribution of Kenworth and Foden heavy duty trucks in New Zealand, the statement said.
Colonial reported operating profit of $13 million for the year ended June 30, 1996, on turnover of $425.17 million.
MBM said the New Zealand Overseas Investment Commission has consented to the acquisition.

MBM, whose stock was suspended from May 24 pending a news announcement, requested the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange to requote its stock with immediate effect. The stock was last traded at 5.85 ringgit. Colonial was last traded at $2.51.
